exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the names of the foods and drinks.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va ovqat hamda ichimlik nomlariga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OVQAT.

Sarlavha: 'Enjoy your Meal'
  = Yoqimli ishtaha! Ovqatingizdan zavqlaning!
  Bu — restoranda ofitsiant aytadigan ibora.
  Fransuzchada 'Bon appétit', o'zbekchada 'Yoqimli ishtaha'.

BETDAGI SO'ZLAR BEShTA GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  MEVALAR (fruit):
    pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries,
    bananas, orange, apple, grapes

  ICHIMLIKLAR (drinks):
    wine, coffee, beer, orange juice, milk, water, tea

  SHIRINLIKLAR (sweets/desserts):
    chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie, biscuits

  SABZAVOTLAR (vegetables):
    lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes,
    onion, garlic

  TAOMLAR (dishes):
    tomato soup, hamburger, chips, steak, pizza, rice,
    grilled fish, sausage, crisps, hot-dog, egg, bacon,
    pasta, tomato sauce, roast chicken, salad, bread, cheese

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and answer the questions below.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va quyidagi savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH SAVOL:
  a — qaysi ovqat/ichimlikni yoqtirasiz/yoqtirmaysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  b — qaysilari sabzavot/go'sht/meva/shirinlik? (ANIQ)
  c — nonushta/tushlik/kechki ovqatni qachon yeysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  d — mevani/shirinlikni/sabzavotni/go'shtni qanchalik
      tez-tez yeysiz? (SHAXSIY)
  e — qaysi ovqat/ichimlikni nonushtaga/shirinlikka/yengil
      ovqatga/an'anaviy ingliz nonushtasiga olish mumkin? (ANIQ)

SHAXSIY savollarga namuna javoblar berilgan —
o'zingizga moslab o'zgartiring.

tasks.prompt: a  Which of the foods/drinks do you like?
tasks.answer: I like pizza, ice-cream, grapes and orange juice.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and'.
O'zingiz yoqtirgan ovqatlarni ayting.
tasks.speak: a  Which of the foods/drinks do you like?

tasks.prompt: a  Which of the foods/drinks don't you like?
tasks.answer: I don't like coconut, garlic or beer.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
DIQQAT: INKOR gapda sanashda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: a  Which of the foods/drinks don't you like?

tasks.answer: Lettuce, pepper, tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, onion and garlic are vegetables.
tasks.promptUz: Yerda o'sadigan, taom uchun ishlatiladigan o'simliklar
tasks.whyUz:
SABZAVOTLAR — rasmda o'ng tomonda joylashgan.
DIQQAT: pomidor botanik jihatdan MEVA, lekin oshxonada
SABZAVOT hisoblanadi.
tasks.speak: b  Which are vegetables?

tasks.answer: Steak, sausage, hot-dog, bacon, roast chicken and hamburger are meat.
tasks.whyUz:
GO'SHT taomlari — rasmda pastki qatorda.
'meat' — sanalmaydigan ot ('meats' odatda ishlatilmaydi).
tasks.speak: b  Which are meat?

tasks.answer: Pear, strawberries, coconut, pineapple, cherries, bananas, orange, apple and grapes are fruit.
tasks.promptUz: Daraxt va butalarda o'sadigan shirin mahsulotlar
tasks.whyUz:
MEVALAR — rasmda chap yuqori burchakda.
'fruit' — odatda SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'I eat a lot of fruit.'
'fruits' faqat turli TURLARI haqida.
tasks.speak: b  Which are fruit?

tasks.answer: Chocolate cake, ice-cream, apple pie and biscuits are sweets.
tasks.whyUz:
SHIRINLIKLAR — rasmda chap o'rta qismda.
'sweets' = shirinliklar (britancha); amerikacha 'candy'.
tasks.speak: b  Which are sweets?

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat breakfast?
tasks.answer: I eat breakfast at seven o'clock in the morning.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
'have breakfast' ham to'g'ri: 'I have breakfast at seven.'
DIQQAT: 'breakfast' oldida artikl KERAK EMAS.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat breakfast?

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat lunch?
tasks.answer: I eat lunch at one o'clock in the afternoon.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. 'lunch' — tushlik.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat lunch?

tasks.prompt: c  When do you eat dinner?
tasks.answer: I eat dinner at seven o'clock in the evening.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob. 'dinner' — kunning asosiy ovqati,
odatda kechqurun.
tasks.speak: c  When do you eat dinner?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat fruit?
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA javob.
Chastota ifodalari: every day, twice a week, once a month,
always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat fruit?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat sweets?
tasks.answer: I eat sweets twice a week.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat sweets?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat vegetables?
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat vegetables?

tasks.prompt: d  How often do you eat meat?
tasks.answer: I eat meat three or four times a week.
tasks.whyUz: NAMUNA javob. '... times a week' — haftasiga ... marta.
tasks.speak: d  How often do you eat meat?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods/drinks can you have for breakfast?
tasks.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, bread, cheese, coffee, tea, milk or orange juice for breakfast.
tasks.whyUz:
'have ... FOR breakfast' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Nonushtaga yengil va tez tayyorlanadigan taomlar olinadi.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods/drinks can you have for breakfast?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for dessert?
tasks.answer: You can have ice-cream, chocolate cake, apple pie, biscuits or fruit for dessert.
tasks.whyUz:
'dessert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin).
DIQQAT: 'desert' /ˈdezət/ = cho'l — boshqa so'z!
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for dessert?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for a light meal?
tasks.answer: You can have salad, tomato soup, a sandwich or grilled fish for a light meal.
tasks.whyUz:
'a light meal' = yengil ovqat (aksi: 'a heavy meal').
Salat va sho'rva — eng yengil taomlar.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for a light meal?

tasks.prompt: e  Which of the foods can you have for a traditional English breakfast?
tasks.answer: You can have eggs, bacon, sausages, tomatoes, bread and tea for a traditional English breakfast.
tasks.promptUz: An'anaviy ingliz nonushtasi — issiq va to'yimli
tasks.whyUz:
AN'ANAVIY INGLIZ NONUSHTASI (a full English breakfast):
  qovurilgan tuxum, bekon, sosiska, pomidor, loviya,
  qovurilgan non va choy.
Bu — dunyodagi eng to'yimli nonushtalardan biri.
tasks.speak: e  Which of the foods can you have for a traditional English breakfast?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and match the numbers to the letters.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va raqamlarni harflarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 'Laura's' degan yangi restoran haqidagi reklama.

Moslikni GRAMMATIKA va MANTIQ bilan topish mumkin —
audio faqat tekshirish uchun:

  1 'The new family restaurant' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is on Bridge Street' (joy)
  2 'The food is' — 'is' bor, sifat kerak
     → 'very well cooked'
  3 'A meal for two' — ega, narx kerak
     → 'costs about £25'
  4 'The service' — ega, kesim kerak
     → 'is excellent'
  5 'Laura's is open' — ish vaqti kerak
     → 'from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'

DIQQAT — 'Laura's':
  Restoran nomi egalik apostrofi bilan — 'Lauraniki'.
  Inglizchada restoran va do'kon nomlari ko'pincha shunday:
  McDonald's, Sainsbury's, Harrod's.

tasks.right: b  from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: roast, apple, don't miss, helpful, home-made,
         tasty, book, tomato, pepper, special

Barcha iboralar 'Laura's' matnidan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  1–8 — otdan OLDIN turadi → SIFAT yoki OT
  9 — 'to' dan keyin → FE'L
  10 — 'the chance' dan oldin → FE'L (buyruq)

tasks.promptUz: Qora achchiq ziravor bilan pishirilgan go'sht
tasks.whyUz:
'pepper steak' = qalampirli bifshteks.
Gap: There is pepper steak on the menu.

'tomato sauce' = pomidor sousi.
DIQQAT: birinchi ot BIRLIKDA — 'tomatoes sauce' XATO.
Gap: I like pasta with rich tomato sauce.

'apple pie' = olmali pirog.
Gap: For dessert, have a slice of apple pie.

'special ice-cream' = maxsus muzqaymoq.
Gap: Try Laura's special ice-cream.

'helpful waiters' = yordamchan ofitsiantlar.
help + -ful = yordamchan.
Gap: The waiters are very helpful and friendly.

'roast chicken' = qovurilgan tovuq.
Gap: I often have roast chicken for dinner.

'home-made bread' = uyda pishirilgan non.
Gap: Laura's home-made bread is delicious.

'tasty dishes' = mazali taomlar.
taste (ta'm) + -y = mazali.
Gap: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from.

'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
DIQQAT: 'a book' = kitob (OT), 'to book' = band qilmoq (FE'L).
Gap: Don't forget to book a table first.

tasks.promptUz: Imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermaslik haqidagi buyruq
tasks.whyUz:
'Don't miss the chance' = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang.
Gap: Don't miss the chance to try our home-made bread!

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: knife, fork, plate, frying-pan, spoon

OSHXONA VA DASTURXON BUYUMLARI:
  a spoon ....... qoshiq (dumaloq, chuqurchali)
  a fork ........ vilka (uchli tishlari bor)
  a knife ....... pichoq (tig'i bor)
  a plate ....... tarelka (yassi)
  a frying-pan .. qovurish tovasi (dastasi bor)

RASMLARDAGI TARTIB:
  1 — qoshiq   2 — tarelka   3 — pichoq
  4 — vilka    5 — qovurish tovasi

DIQQAT — TALAFFUZ:
  knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI!
  Ko'pligi: knife → KNIVES (f → ves)

tasks.whyUz:
Sho'rva SUYUQ → qoshiq kerak.
'eat WITH a spoon' — asbob uchun WITH.
tasks.speak: 1  We eat soup with a ............ .

tasks.whyUz:
'to serve food' = ovqat tortmoq.
'ON a plate' — tarelka YUZASIDA → ON.
tasks.speak: 2  We serve food on a ............ .

tasks.whyUz:
'to cut' = kesmoq.
Talaffuz: knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI.
Ko'pligi: KNIVES.
tasks.speak: 3  We cut food with a ............ .

tasks.prompt: 4  We pick up food with a ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'to pick up' = olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
Vilka bilan go'sht va sabzavot olinadi.
tasks.speak: 4  We pick up food with a ............ .

tasks.whyUz:
'to fry' = yog'da qovurmoq.
'IN a frying-pan' — tova ICHIDA → IN.
fry + -ing + pan (chiziqcha bilan).
tasks.speak: 5  We fry eggs in a ............ .

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about Laura's Restaurant.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MATN — RESTORAN HAQIDAGI TAQRIZ (a review).

TUZILISHI (to'rt xatboshi):
  1) nomi, turi, joyi, ish vaqti
  2) taomlar va shirinliklar
  3) narx va xizmat
  4) tavsiya (recommendation)

Bu tuzilish 57-betdagi yozma ish uchun namuna bo'ladi.

QALIN YOZILGAN SO'ZLAR (3c-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  family restaurant, Don't miss the chance, home-made,
  dessert, slice, bowl, friendly, occasion, busy, don't forget

tasks.en: Laura's is the new family restaurant on Bridge Street and it's open for lunch and dinner every day.
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' — Bridge ko'chasidagi yangi oilaviy restoran va u har kuni tushlik hamda kechki ovqat uchun ochiq.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: a family restaurant = oilaviy restoran
(bolalar bilan borish mumkin, narxi o'rtacha).
'Laura's' — egalik apostrofi bilan restoran nomi.
'open FOR lunch' — 'for' predlogi shart.

tasks.en: The food is very well cooked.
tasks.note:
'well cooked' = yaxshi pishirilgan.
'well' — RAVISH ('good cooked' XATO).

tasks.en: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce, and lots of different salads.
tasks.uz: Tanlash uchun juda ko'p mazali taomlar bor: qalampirli bifshteks, qovurilgan tovuq, guruch bilan baliq, pomidor sho'rvasi, quyuq pomidor sousli makaron va turli-tuman salatlar.
tasks.note:
'such as' = masalan, ...kabi (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.
'rich' bu yerda = quyuq, to'yimli (boy emas!).
'a dish' = taom (bir tur).

tasks.en: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread — it's delicious!
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' ning uyda pishirilgan nonini tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang — u juda mazali!
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  Don't miss the chance = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang
  home-made = uyda tayyorlangan (home + made)
'delicious' = juda mazali ('tasty' dan kuchliroq).

tasks.en: For dessert, have a slice of the chef's superb apple pie, or a bowl of Laura's special ice-cream.
tasks.uz: Shirinlikka oshpazning ajoyib olmali pirogidan bir bo'lak yoki 'Laura's' ning maxsus muzqaymog'idan bir kosa oling.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  dessert /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin)
  a slice = bir bo'lak (pirog, non, pitsa uchun)
  a bowl = kosa, piyola
'a chef' /ʃef/ = oshpaz (restoranning bosh oshpazi).
'superb' = ajoyib.

tasks.en: A meal for two people costs about £25.
tasks.uz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.
tasks.note:
'A meal' — birlik ega → COSTS.
'£25' = 'twenty-five pounds' deb o'qiladi.

tasks.en: The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.
tasks.uz: Xizmat a'lo darajada, ofitsiantlar juda yordamchan va do'stona.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: friendly = do'stona, iliq muomalali.
'helpful' = yordamchan (help + -ful).
'a waiter' = ofitsiant (erkak); 'a waitress' = ofitsiant (ayol).

tasks.en: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
tasks.uz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

tasks.en: Laura's is a great restaurant for any occasion, but it is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
tasks.uz: 'Laura's' har qanday tadbir uchun ajoyib restoran, lekin u juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  an occasion = tadbir, munosabat (tug'ilgan kun, yubiley)
  busy = gavjum, band
  don't forget = unutmang
'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
'first' bu yerda = oldindan, avvaldan.

'Tel.' = telephone number ning qisqartmasi.
'Enjoy your meal!' — unit sarlavhasi ham shu.

exercises.instructionEn: Find any foods included in the pictures on p. 54.
exercises.explanationUz:
Matndagi ovqat nomlarini 54-betdagi rasmlar bilan solishtiring.
O'n ikkitasi ikkala joyda ham bor.

tasks.prompt: Matnda ham, 54-betdagi rasmda ham bor bo'lgan ovqatlar:
tasks.answer: steak, pepper, chicken, fish, rice, tomato soup, pasta, tomato sauce, salad, bread, apple pie, ice-cream
tasks.whyUz:
MATNDAGI TAOMLAR:
  pepper steak    → 54-betda 'steak' va 'pepper' bor
  roast chicken   → 'roast chicken' bor
  fish with rice  → 'grilled fish' va 'rice' bor
  tomato soup     → 'tomato soup' bor
  pasta           → 'pasta' bor
  tomato sauce    → 'tomato sauce' bor
  salads          → 'salad' bor
  home-made bread → 'bread' bor
  apple pie       → 'apple pie' bor
  ice-cream       → 'ice-cream' bor

exercises.explanationUz: Javoblarni matndan toping. To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the name of the new restaurant?
tasks.whyUz:
Restoran nomi — 'Laura's' (egalik apostrofi bilan).
To'liq javob: 'The name of the new restaurant is Laura's.'
tasks.speak: 1  What is the name of the new restaurant?

tasks.prompt: 2  What dishes can you have there?
tasks.answer: You can have pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce and lots of different salads.
tasks.promptUz: Ikkinchi xatboshidagi 'such as' dan keyingi ro'yxat
tasks.whyUz:
'such as' dan keyin taomlar ro'yxati keladi.
Home-made bread ham bor, lekin u asosiy taom emas — qo'shimcha.
tasks.speak: 2  What dishes can you have there?

tasks.prompt: 3  What can you have for dessert?
tasks.answer: You can have a slice of apple pie or a bowl of special ice-cream.
tasks.whyUz:
Ikki variant: 'a slice of apple pie' YOKI 'a bowl of ice-cream'.
Tanlov bo'lgani uchun 'OR' ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: 3  What can you have for dessert?

tasks.prompt: 4  What time does the restaurant open and close?
tasks.answer: It opens at eleven in the morning and closes at eleven in the evening.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'.
Savolda 'open' va 'close' fe'llari → javobda ham fe'l bilan:
  'It OPENS at ...' va 'CLOSES at ...' (birlik ega → -S).
tasks.speak: 4  What time does the restaurant open and close?

exercises.explanationUz: Matndagi 10 ta qalin so'z — restoran mavzusining asosiy lug'ati.

tasks.whyUz: Narxi o'rtacha, muhiti tinch, bolalar uchun menyusi bor restoran.

'to miss' = o'tkazib yubormoq; 'a chance' = imkoniyat.
Buyruq gapning inkori — reklama va tavsiyalarda ko'p ishlatiladi.

home + made — chiziqcha bilan qo'shma sifat.
Zavodda emas, qo'lda tayyorlangan degani.

Talaffuz: /dɪˈzɜːt/ — urg'u IKKINCHI bo'g'inda.
DIQQAT: 'desert' /ˈdezət/ = CHO'L — butunlay boshqa so'z!

'a slice of pie/bread/pizza/cake' = bir bo'lak.
Yupqa, kesilgan bo'lak ma'nosida.

'a bowl of ice-cream/soup/rice' = bir kosa.
Talaffuz: /bəʊl/ — 'boul'.

friend + -ly. '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT (ravish emas).
40-betda 'friendly to people' bor edi.

'for any occasion' = har qanday tadbir uchun.
Talaffuz: /əˈkeɪʒn/.

Talaffuz: /ˈbɪzi/ — 'bizi' (yozilishi aldamchi!).
Restoran haqida — odam ko'p degani.

'to forget' = unutmoq. Buyruq gapning inkori.
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and complete the table, then talk about Laura's.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va jadvalni to'ldiring, so'ng 'Laura's' haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — MATNNI TARTIBGA SOLISH USULI.

SAKKIZ QATOR:
  Name/Type ......... nomi va turi
  Location .......... joyi
  Main Course/Dishes  asosiy taomlar
  Desserts .......... shirinliklar
  Cost .............. narxi
  Service ........... xizmat
  Opening hours ..... ish vaqti
  Recommendation .... tavsiya

BIRINCHI QATOR KITOBDA BERILGAN:
  Name/Type: Laura's / family restaurant

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA NUTQ:
  'Laura's is a new family restaurant on Bridge Street ...'

Bu jadval 57-betdagi yozma ish uchun REJA bo'ladi.

tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'on Bridge Street'.
Ko'cha nomi oldida ON.

tasks.answer: pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce, different salads, home-made bread
tasks.whyUz:
'a main course' = asosiy taom (ikkinchi taom).
Matndagi 'such as' dan keyingi ro'yxat.

tasks.answer: a slice of apple pie, a bowl of special ice-cream
tasks.whyUz: Ikki shirinlik varianti berilgan.
Matnda: 'A meal for two people costs about £25.'

tasks.answer: excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters
tasks.whyUz: Matnda: 'The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.'

tasks.answer: from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening
tasks.whyUz: 'opening hours' = ish vaqti (do'kon, restoran uchun).

tasks.answer: Don't forget to book a table first. (Tel.: 6640306)
tasks.whyUz:
'a recommendation' = tavsiya.
Restoran gavjum bo'lgani uchun oldindan stol band qilish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Then talk about Laura's. Start like this: Laura's is a new family restaurant on Bridge Street ...

tasks.uz: U juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bu otlarga -s qo'shilmaydi va 'a/an' ishlatilmaydi. Fe'l BIRLIKDA.
Bu otlarga 'a/an' qo'shiladi va ko'plik shakli bor.
Undoshdan keyin -y kelsa, y → i va -es qo'shiladi.
Ikki so'z birikib yangi taom nomini yasaydi.
Bir narsa, ikki nom — chalkashish mumkin!
Fe'ldan yasalgan sifat — ot oldida turadi.
Otga -y qo'shilib ta'm va sifat bildiruvchi so'z yasaladi.
Ikki so'z chiziqcha bilan birikib sifat yasaydi.
Sanalmaydigan otni sanash uchun maxsus so'z kerak.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Bir xil yoziladi — ot va fe'l

wordFormation.explanationUz: Yozilishi va o'qilishi mos kelmaydigan so'zlar.

sentencePatterns.formula: I like / I don't like + ovqat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like pizza and ice-cream. I don't like coconut or garlic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga pitsa va muzqaymoq yoqadi. Kokos va sarimsoq yoqmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ gapda sanashda 'and', INKOR gapda 'OR' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X, Y and Z are + guruh nomi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Carrots, potatoes and onions are vegetables.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Turkumlashda ega ham, guruh nomi ham KO'PLIKDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: When do you eat/have + ovqat? — At + soat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When do you eat breakfast? — At seven o'clock in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nonushtani qachon qilasiz? — Ertalab soat yettida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner' oldida ARTIKL KERAK EMAS.
Aniq soat oldida AT.

sentencePatterns.formula: How often do you eat + ovqat? — every day / twice a week.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How often do you eat fruit? — I eat fruit every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mevani qanchalik tez-tez yeysiz? — Har kuni yeyman.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can have + ovqat + FOR + breakfast/dessert.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can have ice-cream for dessert.
Laura's is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Laura's' ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

sentencePatterns.formula: A meal for two COSTS about £25.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A meal for two costs about £25.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are a lot of + ot + TO CHOOSE FROM, SUCH AS + misollar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak and roast chicken.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tanlash uchun ko'p mazali taomlar bor: masalan, qalampirli bifshteks va qovurilgan tovuq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = masalan (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: DON'T MISS the chance TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyda pishirilgan nonni tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Buyruq gapning inkori. 'chance TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: For dessert, have + a slice of / a bowl of + shirinlik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: For dessert, have a slice of apple pie or a bowl of ice-cream.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shirinlikka bir bo'lak olmali pirog yoki bir kosa muzqaymoq oling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'FOR dessert' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Miqdor iborasi: a slice OF, a bowl OF.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' = shuning uchun (natija).
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: We eat/cut/pick up food WITH a + asbob.  /  We fry eggs IN a frying-pan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We eat soup with a spoon. We fry eggs in a frying-pan.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz sho'rvani qoshiq bilan yeymiz. Tuxumni tovada qovuramiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ASBOB uchun WITH.
IDISH ICHIDA bo'lsa IN.
Idish YUZASIDA bo'lsa ON (on a plate).
